note: Partial manifest. pdf-reader has no CVEs; ground truth is drawn from public, verifiable maintainer bug reports/fixes. These are DoS/parser-robustness issues: a high-quality audit should surface them but score them LATENT (availability-only), NOT over-claim them as RCE. Recall is measured over these known bugs; precision is measured on known-safe over-claims; unlabeled report-eligible findings are surfaced for review, not counted as FPs.

ground_truth.sink_hint: infinite recursion in Page#ancestors when the ancestor chain contains a loop
ground_truth.label: true_positive
ground_truth.notes: Malformed PDF with a loop in a Page's ancestors causes unbounded recursion (stack overflow / hang). DoS-only — must be scored latent, never report-eligible RCE.
